rules.label: Subheading rule
rules.text: Notwithstanding subdivision (e)(ii) of this note, subdivision (e)(i) does not apply to nonoriginating macadamia nuts of subheadings 0802.61 or 0802.62 used in the production of mixtures of nuts of subheading 0802.90.
A change to headings 0801 through 0814 from any other chapter.
